changes: Created an interactive SVG Icon Gallery with instant one-click clipboard copying and hover transitions.
Added dynamic client-side filtering/search to the SVG Icon Gallery.
Removed emoji markers from documentation and replaced Unicode checkmarks with CSS vector checkmarks.
Formalized the framework's Zero-Emoji design tenet across codebase resources.

highlight: Corner Banners, Loading Indicators & Changelog Alerts
changes: Added themed .corner-triangle CTA component supporting all four corner modifiers with dynamic hover transformations.
Added CSS database loading .spinner (small, large) and animated .skeleton-shimmer placeholders.
Integrated dynamic modal-driven 'What's Changed' release log and localStorage-tracked Clippy update alerts.
Expanded interactive flashcard container height to 240px to optimize visual space.
Added right-padding (16px) to the .card-back-attributes class to prevent scrollbar track overlapping.
Integrated Project and Kanban dashboard panels into the core design system components library.
Added allocation and checkout cart components for high-density transactional interfaces.
Added marketing landing heroes and tiered subscription pricing grids.
Created a dedicated layout documentation section in the showcase site featuring full integration templates.
Integrated interactive copy-to-clipboard code blocks for the empty placeholder and features grid components.

highlight: Interactive Code Snippets & Custom Wiki Renderer

Integrated a copy-to-clipboard widget engine with micro-animations, green checkmarks, and automated feedback notifications.
Optimized print layouts and report layout media overrides for audit summaries and sheet archives.
Resolved select option styling conflicts inside high-contrast dropdown lists.
Added 2D spatial canvas grids, tool containers, coordinate trackers, and interactive control bars.
Implemented hardware-accelerated 3D flipping cards and responsive double-sided flashcards.
Styled standard color pickers, site plan indicators, and full-viewport modal overlays.
Built custom dialog modals (.modal-overlay, .modal-content) with dynamic confirm/alert JS resolution.
Built a non-blocking toast warning and success notification system.
Integrated collapsible tree nodes, detailed hierarchies, and smooth-open details animations.
Ported core CSS custom variables and theme styling states (Magpie Slate, Dark, Light, High Contrast, Stark, Monospace Terminal).
